note: Static fallback extension store, committed to the site repo so the browser's store keeps working even when the live site host is down. The app tries the live /api/extensions first, then falls back to this file. All packages are official releases from their projects.

extensions.name: uBlock Origin Lite
extensions.author: Raymond Hill / uBlockOrigin
extensions.description: uBO Lite is an MV3 (modern) content blocker: blocks ads, trackers, coin miners and popups while using almost no memory — the successor to uBlock Origin for Chromium.

extensions.name: Dark Reader
extensions.author: Dark Reader Ltd
extensions.description: Eye-care browsing: turns every site into dark mode by analyzing and inverting page colors on the fly. Adjust brightness, contrast and sepia, and schedule per-site themes.
